welcome.title: Welcome to Hypocrates!
welcome.body: Let's quickly set up your dashboard — language, colors, fonts, and the clinic's logo. Every step can be skipped, and everything can be changed later from Settings → Appearance.

language.title: Language
language.body: Which language should the dashboard display?

color.title: Dashboard Colors
color.body: Choose a color palette for your clinic.
color.moreHint: You can also pick a fully custom color later, from Appearance.

font.title: Fonts
font.body: Choose the typeface used across the whole dashboard.
font.moreHint: You can also upload your own font later, from Appearance.

surface.title: Interface Style
surface.body: Solid colored surfaces, or a translucent glass look?

logo.title: Clinic Logo
logo.body: Shown at the top of the sidebar menu.
logo.dropzone: Click or drag your logo here (PNG, JPG, SVG, WEBP)

favicon.title: Browser Tab Icon
favicon.body: Shown in the browser tab, next to the page title.
favicon.dropzone: Click or drag the icon here (PNG, ICO, SVG, JPG)

import.title: Import Your Existing Data
import.body: Already have a list of patients, staff, or prices somewhere else? Upload it now from a CSV or Excel file — or skip this step and do it later.
import.dropzone: Click or drag your file here (CSV, XLSX, XLS)
import.noValidRows: No valid rows in this file
import.laterHint: Finer control (row by row) and import history live at Settings → Import.

finish.title: All set!
finish.body: Your dashboard is configured. Everything can be changed again at any time from Settings → Appearance.
